samples.title: API gateway 503s
samples.alert_text: API gateway requests returned intermittent HTTP 503s across multiple regions. Health checks were flapping and error rates rose while request volume remained steady.

samples.title: CI jobs pending with idle runners
samples.note: A similar fix surfaced through the runner precedent.
samples.alert_text: Jobs waited in the pending queue for several minutes. Runners were idle and the job scheduler showed assignment delays.

samples.title: Container registry uploads stalling
samples.note: Traverse the confirmed configuration relationship in reverse.
samples.alert_text: Container image uploads stalled during manifest publication. Clients retried and the registry returned incomplete upload responses.

samples.title: Learning demo · API gateway
samples.alert_text: The API gateway returns intermittent HTTP 503s. Regional health checks are flapping while request volume remains steady.
samples.resolution_text: API gateway requests returned intermittent HTTP 503s across multiple regions. Health checks were flapping and error rates rose while request volume remained steady. Gateway retries used an invalid upstream setting. Restoring the previous configuration recovered requests.
samples.note: Analyze, resolve the gateway incident with INC-089, and run the same alert again.

samples.title: Learning demo · CI workers
samples.alert_text: CI jobs are queued behind workers and deployment runs are delayed while the pending worker backlog rises.
samples.resolution_text: Deployment jobs were queued while the pending worker backlog rose steadily. Individual executions completed normally. Worker capacity was raised and the queue drained.
samples.note: Confirm the search indexing capacity precedent and inspect the new path.

samples.title: Learning demo · Repository mirrors
samples.alert_text: Git repository mirror requests stall and shared storage operations time out in the primary region.
samples.resolution_text: Git repository mirror requests were slow and shared storage operations timed out in the primary region. A shared storage dependency recovered after a provider repair.
samples.note: Confirm the webhook dependency precedent and rerun the alert.
